purpose: Bind explicit execution authority to one Work Order without executing it or changing permissions.

success_conditions: subject, target, actions, Work Order, expiry, rollback, and stop conditions are bound
negative_tests: missing authority evidence, subject mismatch, over-broad action, or expired grant is rejected

rollback.action: discard the unactivated Capability Grant candidate
rollback.verify: no execution, permission, credential, or Current Truth change occurred
